text:
maya: Quick proposal — we should add a Privacy SLA gating checklist for enterprise launches. Goal: make acceptance deterministic so sales/customer-eng can quote timelines.

maya: Outline suggestion: 1) BYOK/KMS handshake validated, 2) Audit log ingestion + query SLA for 90th pct, 3) Retention tiers configured (customer toggle + legal hold), 4) Cost envelope agreed for 1st-year pilot.

ryan: +1 on deterministic checklist. For audit logs we need minimum schema (timestamp, tenant_id, request_id, model, input_hash, outcome) and an indexing SLA. Can we make the schema a separate artifact?

maya: Yes — separate artifact. I'll draft schema. For the SLA metric: 95th percentile query latency <= 2s for last 30d for index lookups. Thoughts?

jia: 2s seems tight for cold archives. Suggest we define two classes: "hot" (90d, <2s) and "cold" (up to 18mo, best-effort). Pilot should require hot index for last 90d. Cold can be export-on-demand.

sam: Engineering note — hot index means continuous streaming into our search cluster. Cost delta approx +30% for pilot. We'll need budget sign-off.

maya: Good call. So MVP gating: hot index for 90d, cold export for older retention. Add an explicit cost envelope: pilot not to exceed $X/month per tenant (placeholder) — finance will fill.

leah: Legal: we need clarity on exportability and legal-hold semantics. Add requirement: data export must include proof of integrity (hashes) and a legal-hold flag that prevents TTL deletion. Also add a playbook for subpoenas.

maya: Noted. I'll add evidence packaging and legal-hold flag to checklist.

ryan: BYOK/KMS handshake — MVP should include wrap/unwrap key exchange + rotation policy doc. We must also define fallback behavior if KMS unreachable: fail closed or fall back to Redwood-managed keys? Proposal: fail closed for P0 customers, fail-soft (with audit) for others.

jia: We can support fail-closed by blocking encryption operations, but we need an ops runbook for key escrow access and emergency unwrap. Add runbook to gating artifacts.

sam: Technical acceptance criteria for BYOK: successful key import test, rotation test, and a simulated KMS outage where the tenant's production requests are either blocked (fail-closed) or routed to fallback per policy. Include simple test plan.

maya: I'll capture those as pass/fail tests.

maya: Proposed MVP scope (short): \n- Audit schema + hot index (90d) + query SLA acceptance tests\n- BYOK handshake + rotation + outage behavior tests\n- Retention UI toggle + legal-hold flag + export format (compact evidence with hashes)\n- Cost envelope documented and finance ack\n- Ops/Legal runbooks for subpoenas & emergency key access

ryan: Out-of-scope for MVP: merkle proofs, long-term immutable streams, full multi-region replay. We can list them as future features.

leah: Also call out data residency constraints (region tagging) — must be in checklist if customer requires.

maya: Action items: \n- maya: draft checklist + audit schema (due EOD Fri)\n- jia: draft ops runbook for KMS outage (due next Wed)\n- sam: estimate engineering delta & cost delta (due Tue)\n- leah: legal export/hold language and playbook (due next Mon)\n- ryan: add monitoring/alerting requirements for audit index and KMS (due Tue)

maya: If everyone 👍, I'll schedule a 30m sync Wed to align on numbers and sign-off. @ops-bot can you add a calendar invite for Wed 10:30? :calendar: 

ops-bot: Created event: "Privacy SLA gating sync" Wed 10:30 — invites sent to maya, ryan, jia, sam, leah.

sam: Quick Q — retention config JSON idea for UI, e.g.:
```
{
  "retention": [{"tier":"hot","days":90},{"tier":"cold","days":540}],
  "legal_hold": false
}
```

jia: That looks fine. Also include a TTL override API for ops with audit trail.

maya: Great. This gives us a clear, testable gate for enterprise compliance launches. Thanks team.
